notes.title: New Revenge Chapter Update Released!
notes.content:
[p][b]What’s New in This Update?[/b]
After descending the mountain, a whole new stage begins — the [b]Revenge Chapters[/b]. In this update, you’ll infiltrate enemy strongholds, confront your rivals face to face, and settle unfinished scores.[/p][list][*][p]Multiple enemy territories are now open to explore and conquer.[/p][/*][*][p]A variety of new weapons are available to aid you in your battles.[/p][/*][*][p]Each mission brings you closer to vengeance and the truth behind your enemies.[/p][/*][/list]
